executiveSummary: All 5 user stories and 9 functional requirements for iteration 000006 are implemented and comply with the PRD. The gateway correctly forwards modelId, modality, architecture, and components to the worker. The worker's InferRequest Pydantic model declares all required fields. The worker performs per-request model loading (no hardcoded checkpoint at startup) and routes both txt2img and img2img jobs across all four supported architectures exclusively via comfy-diffusion. Error callbacks are fired for unsupported architectures, missing source_image, and invalid base64 payloads. The playground dynamically populates a model selector from GET /v1/models, provides a mode toggle between txt2img and img2img, exposes file upload and denoise_strength controls, and submits { modelId, modality, params } to POST /v1/jobs with SSE-driven result display. Three minor observations are noted but do not constitute non-compliance.

verificationByFR.notes: queue.ts lines 28-31 merge modelId, modality, model.architecture, and model.components into the POST /infer body whenever job.modelId is truthy. The conditional guard is intentional for backward compatibility with job types that pre-date model selection.

worker/src/parallax_worker/models.py declares all five required fields: modality: str, architecture: str, components: dict, source_image: str | None = None, denoise_strength: float = Field(default=0.75, ge=0.0, le=1.0). Fields have defaults for backward compatibility but are validated on receipt.

tasks.py reads MODELS_DIR from the environment (defaulting to /mnt/models/comfyui), instantiates ModelManager(models_dir), and calls _load_model_components with the components dict from the request body at inference time. No weights are loaded at startup.

_load_model_components in tasks.py covers all four architectures (bundled-checkpoint, separate-diffusion-model, separate-unet-dual-clip-image-vae, separate-unet-multi-vae) using comfy_diffusion APIs exclusively (ModelManager, encode_prompt, sample, vae_decode). No direct ComfyUI API calls or other inference libraries are used.

img2img is implemented via vae_encode + denoise parameter passed to sample(). The same four-architecture model-loading path is used; the modality branch in run_inference selects vae_encode vs empty_latent_image accordingly, consistent with the comfy-diffusion API design.

Unsupported architecture raises ValueError (tasks.py line 61-63) caught by the outer except block which POSTs an error callback. A missing required component key raises a KeyError also caught by the same handler. No silent fallbacks exist.

playground.ts fetches /v1/models on page load (IIFE at line 321). Initial select shows 'Loading models…'; on success it populates options with m.id/m.name; on fetch error it shows 'Could not load models' as a disabled option.
The submit handler at line 456 sends JSON.stringify({ modelId, modality, params }) to POST /v1/jobs, placing modelId as a top-level field alongside modality and params.

readFileAsBase64 reads the file as DataURL via FileReader and strips the 'data:<mime>;base64,' prefix before assigning to params.source_image (line 449). The base64 string is sent inside params, not as a separate upload endpoint.

minorObservations: queue.ts: modelId, modality, architecture, and components are only merged into the /infer body when job.modelId is truthy (line 14). FR-1 states 'every body sent to POST /infer'; this conditional means legacy job types (without modelId) will not receive these fields. This appears intentional for backward compatibility but is worth documenting explicitly.

models.py: modality, architecture, and components have default values (empty string / empty dict), making them optional at the Pydantic validation level. The PRD specifies them as required fields with no defaults. A missing modality or architecture in a request will not trigger a 422 validation error — it will default to empty string and the worker will reach _load_model_components with an empty architecture, which will fall through to the ValueError path and post an error callback. Functionally safe but not strictly schema-compliant with the PRD.

tasks.py: an unknown modality value (neither 'txt2img' nor 'img2img') silently falls through to the txt2img branch (empty latent, denoise=1.0). FR-6 covers unsupported architecture but does not explicitly mention unsupported modality. Consider adding an explicit check for unknown modality values to prevent unexpected behavior.

Playground UI — Accessibility: The mode toggle radio group lacks a <fieldset> and <legend> (or role='radiogroup' with aria-labelledby), which reduces screen-reader discoverability. The loading indicator correctly uses aria-live='polite'. The error container uses role='alert'. Addressing the radio group is a low-effort improvement.

Playground UI — Model select loading state: the initial 'Loading models…' option is a disabled placeholder inside a <select> with required. If the fetch resolves with zero models, the submit button remains enabled but the select value is empty — the JS guard (line 428) catches this with a showError call, so the UX is safe, but showing a disabled submit button while models are loading would further improve clarity.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Iteration 000006 is fully compliant with the PRD. All 9 functional requirements and 5 user stories are satisfied by the implemented code. The three actionable minor observations are: (1) add an explicit modality validation in tasks.py to reject unknown modality strings with an error callback rather than silently treating them as txt2img; (2) add <fieldset>/<legend> or role='radiogroup' to the mode toggle for accessibility compliance; (3) document or enforce in code that the /infer body always includes architecture/modality/components (even for non-model jobs, or explicitly restrict POST /v1/jobs to require modelId going forward). None of these gaps block the iteration from being considered complete.
